design.parent: G9 + macro coefficient1 (existing long and short sleeves retained)
design.selection: 2024 only; 2025 and full2026H1 report without reranking
design.objective: portfolio complement: stress-Calmar improvement + .5 relative MDD reduction; standalone profitability not required
design.execution: completed-hour predictors, next5m open; short-only overlay capped by currently positive parent net units, native-event rebalances and parent barrier exits
controls: always-on hedge at each searched coefficient
design.report_finalists: top5 distinct selection paths plus controls
design.caveat: all historical periods already exposed; not pristine OOS or guaranteed new independent alpha

interpretation: Same-instrument net hedge is a dynamic reduction of net long exposure, not independent short alpha when flat.
limitations: Bar/subset conservative MDD not tick ordering.
Down-bar increment is descriptive path attribution, not an independent additive cash PnL series.
